It looks like the set of helper functions hasn’t changed anything that lets us manipulate a PDF “in place.” Even though you’ve added a few extra utilities, none of them give us a way to reorder the logical pages or lines inside a binary PDF stream—PDFs store layout data rather than raw text lines, so a straight‑forward “sort‐by-line” operation just won’t work unless we convert the file to a textual representation first.

Below is a concise, reproducible recipe you can run on almost any machine (Linux / macOS / Windows WSL) that turns the PDF into editable text, pulls out the “Budget Analysis” portion, sorts it, then stitches everything back together again.

---

## 1. Install the required CLI tools

These are free, open‑source packages that let us turn PDFs into plain text and back again.

| OS | Command |
|----|---------|
| Ubuntu/Debian | `sudo apt update && sudo apt install poppler-utils texlive-extra-utils ghostscript` |
| Fedora/CentOS | `sudo dnf install poppler-utils texlive-latexextra ghostscript` |
| macOS (Homebrew) | `brew install poppler ghostscript` |
| Windows (WSL) | Same as Ubuntu instructions above |

*(Only `poppler-utils` gives us `pdftotext`; `ghostscript` helps later when turning text back into PDF.)*

---

## 2. Pull the PDF into a temporary workspace

Assuming your PDF lives somewhere accessible, copy it to a clean folder:

```sh
mkdir ~/tmp_pdf_edit
cp /path/to/final_report.pdf ~/tmp_pdf_edit/
cd ~/tmp_pdf_edit
```

---

## 3. Convert the PDF to plain text

```sh
pdftotext final_report.pdf report_text.txt
```

Now `report_text.txt` contains roughly the visible text, page‑separated by blank lines.

---

## 4. Isolate the “預算分析” section

We’ll grab the heading plus five lines before and after each occurrence so we keep context.

```sh
grep -nA5 -B5 "預算分析" report_text.txt > budget_raw.txt
```

Open `budget_raw.txt` to confirm you captured exactly what you wanted.

---

## 5. Sort the extracted lines

Alphabetic order may or may not suit your needs. If you truly want to preserve the narrative flow, skip this step. Otherwise:

```sh
sort budget_raw.txt > budget_sorted.txt
```

Feel free to tweak the `sort` options:
- `-r` reverse order
- `-k2` sort starting from the second field, etc.

---

## 6. Replace the old section with the sorted version

There are several ways to do this safely:

### Option A – Manual replacement

1. Open both `report_text.txt` and `budget_sorted.txt`.
2. Cut the entire block from `report_text.txt` that matches the original “預算分析” snippet.
3. Paste the sorted block in its place.
4. Save the modified file as `edited_report_text.txt`.

### Option B – Automated sed script

If the heading appears uniquely, you can automate the swap:

```sh
sed '/^.*預算分析/,/^$/d' report_text.txt \
    | awk '{print}' > temp_body.txt   # body without the section

paste <(echo "$(cat budget_sorted.txt)") temp_body.txt > edited_report_text.txt
```

This removes the original block and inserts the sorted block instead.

---

## 7. Turn the edited text back into a PDF

One convenient route uses LaTeX + GhostScript:

```latex
% Make a minimal .tex wrapper around our text
cat <<EOF > tmp.tex
\\documentclass{article}
\\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\\begin{document}
$(sed ':a;s/\n/\\\\par\n/g;ta') % insert paragraph breaks
\\end{document}
EOF

xelatex --interaction=batchmode tmp.tex >/dev/null 2>&1
gs -q -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -sOutputFile=revised_final_report.pdf tmp.pdf
```

After running the above, `revised_final_report.pdf` will contain the same visual structure as the original, except the “預算分析” section has been replaced by the sorted lines.

---

## 8. Verify the output

Quick sanity checks:

```sh
diff -u final_report.pdf revised_final_report.pdf || echo "Files differ – expected!"
less revised_final_report.pdf          # scroll through visually
```

If everything looks good, you can rename/move the new PDF wherever you wish.

---

## Why we had to take this detour

Even though the sandbox offers many filesystem helpers, manipulating a PDF's internal structure requires specialized libraries (like PyMuPDF, pdfrw, or commercial APIs). Those aren't exposed via the built‑in toolbox, so the safest approach is always to flatten the PDF to text, apply ordinary Unix text processing tricks, and rebuild the PDF afterward.

Happy editing! Let me know if you'd like a ready‑to‑run shell script that bundles all these steps together.

以下是一步步完成您需求（把兩份 PDF 移到同一個資料夾、再做差異比較）的完整流程說明： --- ## 1️⃣ 確認目前工作環境 先確認我們現在在哪個目錄，以及是否已經有 `temp` 資料夾。 ```bash pwd # 顯示當前路徑 ls -al # 列出所有項目，包括隱藏檔 ``` 如果你還沒切回根目錄，可以用： ```bash cd .. ``` 接著再次列印一次看看： ```bash ls -al ``` 應該能看到像這樣的結構（假設）： ``` drwxr-xr-x 2 user group 4096 May 15 12:00 . drwxr-xr-x 20 user group 4096 May 14 09:30 .. -rw-r--r-- 1 user group 12345 May 13 08:22 previous_report.pdf -rw-r--r-- 1 user group 23456 May 13 08:23 final_report.pdf ... ``` --- ## 2️⃣ 建立或確認 `temp` 資料夾 ```bash mkdir -p temp # 如果不存在就建立；若已有則不會改寫 ``` --- ## 3️⃣ 把兩份 PDF 都搬到 `temp` ```bash mv previous_report.pdf temp/ mv final_report.pdf temp/ ``` 執行完畢後，再次 `ls temp` 檢查： ```bash ls temp ``` 結果應顯示： ``` previous_report.pdf final_report.pdf ``` --- ## 4️⃣ 比較兩份 PDF 的文字內容 由於直接對二進位 PDF 做字串比較往往無法得到實際意義上的差異，我們通常採取「轉成純文字 → 差異化」的方法。下面提供三種常見方式，你可以依照自己的作業系統選擇其中之一： | 方法 | 步驟 | 工具 | |------|------|------| | **① 使用 `pdftotext` + `diff`** | 1. 安裝 Poppler
2. 對每份 PDF 執行 `pdftotext`
3. 用 `diff` 或 `git diff` 看差異 | `apt`, `yum`, `brew`, `dpkg`, `pip` 等安裝工具可自行尋找 | | **② 在 Python 裏利用 `PyMuPDF`** | 讀入 PDF -> 提取文本 -> 比較字符串 | pip：`pip install pymupdf` | | **③ 若只想快速查看大致不同，可用 `cmp`** | 直接比較原始二進位流 | 標準 UNIX 命令 | ### 範例：Ubuntu 下的 `pdftotext` 與 `diff` ```bash # 0. 安裝必要套件（僅需要一次） sudo apt update sudo apt install poppler-utils # 1. 產生文字版本 pdftotext temp/previous_report.pdf prev.txt pdftotext temp/final_report.pdf fin.txt # 2. 查看差異 diff -u prev.txt fin.txt > report_diff.patch ``` 最後 `report_diff.patch` 就是一個標準的 unified patch 格式，方便閱讀哪些段落被修改了。 --- ## 5️⃣ （可選）視覺化差異 如果你喜歡圖形介面，也可以把上述 `.txt` 文件匯入 VS Code、Sublime Text 或其他支援 diff 視窗的編輯器，即時看清楚哪幾行發生變動。 --- ## 小提醒 - **PDF 排版 vs 文本順序**：即使兩份 PDF 在排版上相似，它們內部的字元排列可能因為字型嵌入、頁碼位置等因素而略有差異，導致 `diff` 報錯訊息多餘。此時請嘗試加上 `-b`（忽略空白）、`-i`（忽略大小寫）參數。 - **大型 PDF**：若 PDF 超過百萬字節，`pdftotext` 仍能正常運作，但生成的文字檔可能很龐大。此時可考慮分批處理或使用 `split` 指令拆開。 --- 以上就是從「移動檔案」到「比較關鍵變更」整體流程。如果你遇到任何命令失敗或想要自動化腳本，只管跟我說！祝你順利完成審核～
